title: Model declarations
description: What the models a workspace uses can do, as its author declares it. Placed at .prumo/models.json. It is a declaration and never a measurement: no provider publishes its models' features in a form a client can read, so the harness reports what somebody wrote down and marks everything else as undeclared. An absent feature is the absence of a claim, not a denial.

version.description: Format revision, so a reader can tell an old file from a new one.

models.description: Model id (as the provider names it) → what it can do.

text.description: Serves prose. Absent means nobody claimed it.

reasoning.description: Reports its reasoning, separately from the answer.

vision.description: Reads images. This is the flag the harness gates an image reference on: a model that does not declare it receives the reference as text.

context_tokens.description: The window the model accepts, when the author knows it. A client that receives no window reports what a run spent and no share of a budget.
